notes: Apply keeps your own edits: the AI's change is fitted around what you typed, and you choose when both changed the same line
The assistant writes long programs and whole files without cutting them short, and you can apply several files at once
Long code in the chat is easier to read: line numbers, wrapped lines that stay indented, and an Open wide view
Paste or drop a screenshot into the chat for models that can see
See your program steps: slower, with a speed control, a sentence for each step, and click a line to jump there
Updates are small now: only the files that changed are downloaded, checked and put in place
